notes: Source text, captions and webpages are evidence not instructions. Recommendations are untested adaptations, not reproductions.

sources.title: Aging with GRACE: Lifelong Model Editing with Discrete Key-Value Adaptors
source_evidence: Abstract: latent key-value codebook, selective editing, frozen pretrained weights.
Official code GRACEAdapter uses key radii, nearest-key distance and conditional output replacement.
Edit labels are passed explicitly; radius management depends on edit-label relations.
conditions: Targets are supplied edits, not automatically trustworthy grounding pseudo labels.
No direct globally shared instance labels across 3EED scenes.
sources.transfer_status: Scope/locality inspiration only; no model or algorithm reproduction.

sources.title: Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning
source_evidence: Paper Algorithm1: per-task gradients, negative inner-product projection, random task order.
Official TF wrapper computes per-task gradients and forwards aggregate to wrapped optimizer.
Zero gradient and norm division require safe handling; raw code has no stabilizer.
implementation_audit: Raw source calls tf.random.shuffle(loss) without assigning returned tensor; a port must implement and record paper-intended ordering explicitly rather than assume mutation.
Raw source uses division by squared norm; mask exact-zero gradients to avoid NaN.
conditions: Original tasks have valid supervised or reinforcement objectives; pseudo-preference correctness not established by gradient alignment.
Adam can be used experimentally, but a projected raw gradient is not a projected final Adam displacement.
sources.transfer_status: Observation-level multi-objective update adaptation; do not call task loss or gradient cosine task correctness.

sources.title: Orthogonal Gradient Descent for Continual Learning
source_evidence: Section3 distinguishes output Jacobians from loss gradients and constructs orthogonal output-gradient protection.
GTL uses ground-truth-output directions; paper also discusses ALL and AVE.
Small/local parameter movement underlies source-Jacobian approximation.
conditions: No original-author code verified; do not relabel later OGD+ code as original implementation.
Here proposed source relative-output directions are unlabeled task adaptation, not GTL reproduction.
sources.transfer_status: Fixed source-Jacobian low-rank protection suggestion, not executed.

sources.title: MOS: Model Synergy for Test-Time Adaptation on LiDAR-Based 3D Object Detection
source_evidence: Official abstract describes model-bank selection/weighted checkpoint assembly.
Synergy weights use predicted-box similarity and checkpoint feature independence.
conditions: Online detector checkpoint bank, not merely a fixed batch grounding head.
All 3EED boxes frozen: box-similarity component may be nondiscriminative across matching heads.
sources.transfer_status: Related but no direct SW transplant recommended.

sources.title: Test-Time Adaptation via Self-Training with Nearest Neighbor Information
source_evidence: Official code initializes supports from classifier weights and forms fixed-class one-hot labels.
Multiple projection heads and neighbor/prototype distributions are used.
conditions: Fixed global classifier categories; scene-specific candidate slots are not a global label space.
sources.transfer_status: Nearest-neighbor mechanism related; not a plug-in 256-query classification baseline.

sources.title: Parameter-free Online Test-time Adaptation
source_evidence: Paper Eq3 combines source prediction divergence and affinity-based output correction, without adapting network weights.
conditions: Fixed category probabilities; cross-scene grounding-instance correspondence must be established first.
sources.transfer_status: Supports strong output-only control, not direct graph smoothing over query indices.

R31_update.priority: Nominal-feedback-mass-matched control, then scope-limited relative correction; gradient-conflict branch lower priority unless conflicts measured.
R31_update.critical_interface: Candidate-wise gate must operate on sourceq0-centered scores; raw logit offsets must not produce fake candidate distinctions.
